A dream realised in Portimão 🩵
Joshua Dürksen has made history as the first Paraguayan to drive a modern Formula One car, completing his first test in the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS W16.
Read the full story on our website 👉 https://bit.ly/JoshTestWebX
detailZh:
在波尔蒂芒诺实现的梦想 🩵

阅读完整故事请访问我们的网站 👉 https://bit.ly/JoshTestWebX
